EPC-025.title: the coordination ledger: follow-ups and lanes
EPC-025.deliverable: After this merges into the EPC-022 line and then `main`, any orchestrating or lone session, on any harness or model, can see and follow up every open commitment and every lane from disk, across restarts, usage limits, lost transcripts and a change of coordinator, and nothing handed over goes quiet. The operator approved the design on 2026-10-23 (cf-present session `dac94188`, `approve_with_notes` at revision 9) with three notes, folded in: direct work by the coordinator is tracked as a follow-up with no lane; a seat the new coordinator's harness cannot reach is judged by its own heartbeat and reports, never assumed dead, and replaced on its resources only with stopped-work evidence or a resolved overlap; and the data model ships with a field-level schema reference and a figure. Decided by the operator on 2026-10-22: the name "coordination ledger"; location A (clone-local), JSON Lines, one ledger per project (per clone, one machine), work streams `WS-NNN` with one live coordinator each so several coordinators run at once within and across harnesses, any session may add follow-ups, only the holder closes, closure on proof; lane scope is descriptive (task, tasks, epic or topic) and changes as events; `check interval` 10 minutes and `heartbeat timeout` 30 minutes, configurable, timeout longer than interval; takeover only by explicit `adopt`; the turn-end check warns by default and a policy key can make it blocking outside tracked delegate sessions; only a stream's coordinator opens or closes its lanes. Still open for the operator: the Codex hook route (TSK-440 establishes it). | Issue | Tasks | |---|---| | https://github.com/sathyassn/codeflow/issues/272 | TSK-422 (contracts, store and `follow`), TSK-439 (lanes, attempts, seats, the coordinator lease, the parent link and session fields), TSK-1126 (reports flow up the tree), TSK-440 (surfaces on three harnesses and the tree view), TSK-423 (rules, skills, the three roles and the fresh-context proof) |
